spans.s:
अपि ind. (Sometimes with the अ
dropped according to the opinion of
Bhāguri; वष्टि भागुरिरल्लोपमवाप्योरुपसर्गयोः;
पिधा, पिधान &c.)
1 (Used with roots
and nouns in the sense of) Placing
near or over, taking towards,
uniting with; reaching or going up to,
proximity, nearness &c. [Cf. Gr.
epi, Zend api, Germ. and Eng. be].
(Note. अपि, as a prefix to roots, occurs
mostly in Veda, its place being taken
by अभि in classical literature).
--2 (As
a separable adverb or conjunction)
And, also, too, moreover, besides, in
addition, having a cumulative force
(समुच्चय); अस्ति मे सोदरस्नेहोप्येतेषु; Ś. 1
on one's part, in one's turn;
विष्णुशर्मणापि राजपुत्राः पाटिताः

Sk.,
न नापि-न चैव, न वापि, नापि वा न चापि
neither-nor; न वापि काव्यं नवमित्यवद्यं

nor; वापि or; अल्पोप्येवं महान्
वापि

whether small or great.
--3 It is often used to express
emphasis in the sense of ‘too’, ‘even’
‘very’; विधुरपि विधियोगाद् ग्रस्यते
राहणासौ

.
--4 Though (oft. translateable
by ‘even’, ‘even if’); सरसिजमनुविद्धं
शैवलेनापि रम्यं Ś. 1. 20 though
overspread &c.; इयमधिकमनोज्ञा वल्कलेनापि
तन्वी ibid. though in her bark dress;
बलवदपि शिक्षितानाम् 1. 2 though ever
so learned. In this sense अपि is most
frequently used by writers to show
real or imaginary opposition (विरोध);
कृष्णमपि असुदर्शनं, पुष्पवत्यपि पवित्रा &c.
--5
But, however.
--6 Used at the
beginning of sentences अपि introduces
a question; अपि सन्निहितोऽत्र कुलपतिः
Ś. 1; अपि क्रियार्थं सुलभं समित्कुशं… अपि
स्वशक्त्या तपसि प्रवर्तसे

.
--7 Hope,
[]
expectation (usually with the potential
mood); कृतं रामसदृशं कर्म । अपि जीवेत्स
ब्राह्मणशेशुः

. I hope the Brāhmaṇa
boy comes to life. Note-In this
sense अपि is frequently used with
नाम and has the sense of (a) ‘is it
likely’, ‘may it be’; (b)
‘perhaps’, ‘in all probability’ or (c)
‘would that’, ‘I wish or hope’
that’; अपि नाम
कुलपतोरियमसवर्णक्षेत्रसंभवा स्यात् Ś. 1; Ś. 7; तदपि नाम
मनागवतीर्णोसि रतिरमणबाणगोचरं

perhaps, in all probability; अपि नाम
तयोः कल्याणिनोः अभिमतः पाणिग्रहः
स्यात् ibid.; अपि नाम रामभद्रः पुनरपीदं
वनमलंकुर्यात्

; ‘is it likely’, ‘I wish’;
यथा वनज्योत्स्नानुरूपेण पादपेन संगता
अपि नाम एवमहमप्यात्मनोऽनुरूपं वरं
लभेयेति Ś. 1 would that; अपि नामाहं
पुरूरवा भवेयं

I wish I were P.
--8 Affixed to interrogative words
अपि makes the sense indefinite,
‘any’, ‘some’; कोपि some one; किमपि
something; कुत्रापि somewhere; कदापि
at any time; कथमपि any how &c.
केऽपि एते प्रवयसः त्वां दिदृक्षवः

some people. It may often be
translated by ‘unknown’,
‘indescribable,’ ‘inexpressible’ (अनिर्वाच्य);
व्यतिषजति पदार्थानांतरः कोपि हेतुः

; तत्तस्य किमपि द्रव्यं यो हि यस्य
प्रियो जनः 2. 19;

.
--9 After words
expressing number अपि has the
sense of ‘totality’, ‘all’; चतुर्णामपि
वर्णानां of all the 4 castes; सर्वैरपि
राज्ञां प्रयोजनं

.
--10 It sometimes
expresses ‘doubt’ or ‘uncertainty,’
‘fear’ (शंका); अपि चोरो भवेत् G. M.
there is perhaps a thief.
--11 (with
pot. mood) It has the sense of संभावना
‘possibility’, ‘supposition’;

; धिग्देवदत्तमपि स्तुयाद्वृषलं; धिग्जाल्मं
देवदत्तमपि सिंचेत् पलांडुं; अपि जायां
त्यजसि जातु गणिकामाधत्से गर्हितमेतत् Sk.
shame to, &c. or fie upon, Devadatta
&c.
--13 It is also used with the
Imperative mood to mark ‘indifference
on the part of the speaker’, where
he permits another to do as he likes,
(अन्ववसर्ग or कामचारानुज्ञा, the imperative
being softened;) अपि स्तुहि Sk. you
[]
may praise (if you like); अपि स्तुह्यपि
सेधास्मांस्तथ्यमुक्तं नराशन

.
--14 अपि is sometimes used as a
particle of exclamation,
--15 Rarely in the
sense of ‘therefore,’ ‘hence’ (अत एव).
--16 Used as a separable preposition
with gen. it is said to express the
sense of a word understood (पदार्थ),
and is treated as a कर्मप्रवचनीय

; the example usually given is
सर्पिषोपि स्यात् where some word like
बिंदुरपि ‘a drop,’ ‘a little’ &c.
has to be understood, ‘there may
perhaps be a drop of ghee,’ ‘I
presume there may be at least a drop’
&c. अपि संभावनाप्रश्नशंकागर्हासमुच्चये ।
तथायुक्तपदार्थेषु कामचारक्रियासु च ॥ Viśva.; अपिः
पदार्थसंभावनान्ववसर्गगर्हासमुच्चयेषु

.
G. M. adds the senses of आशिस्
‘blessing’ (भद्रमपि), मृति ‘death’ (मरणमपि)
and भूषा ‘decoration’ (अपि न ह्यति हारं).

अपी [अपि-इ] {c2c} P. (Mostly
Vedic)
1 To go in or near, enter into
or upon, approach.
--2 To have a
share in, partake of, suffer; जरामृत्युं
पुनरेवापियंति Muṇḍ.
--3 To join, flow,
flow into, dissolve, be resolved into;
स्वमपीतो भवति तस्मादेनं स्वपितीत्याचक्षते
Ch. Up.
--4 To die.
--5 To pour out
(as a river).

आपी a. Fat, stout.
--पीः f. The
20th Nakṣatra or lunar mansion.

अपिकक्षः Ved. The region of
the arm-pits and shoulder-blades,
especially in animals.
--क्षं ind. In
the armpit.

अपिकक्ष्य a. Belonging to this
region (Sāy. on

says
˚क्ष्यं छिन्नस्य यज्ञशिरसः कक्षप्रदेशेन संधानभूतं
प्रवर्ग्यविद्याख्यं रहस्यं).

अपिकर्णं The region of the ears;
near (समीप)

अपिगीर्ण a.
1 Praised,
celebrated.
--2 Told, described.

अपिच्छिल a.
1 Not muddy, clear,
free from sediment.
--2 Deep.

अपिज a. Born after or again,
epithet of several deities.
--जः
[अपि अप्सु जायते, अलुक् वेदे
अप्शब्दस्यैकवचनत्वमपि] N. of the month
ofJyeṣṭha (जलक्रीडारतिसाधनत्वात्तथात्वं).

अपित् a. [आपः इतो गता यस्य वेदे न
जष्]
1 Dry, waterless, as a river.
--2 Not having the इत् or अनुबंध प्.

अपितृक a.
1 Fatherless.
--2 Not
ancestral or paternal, not inherited
(अपैतृक also in this sense).

अपित्वं Ved. [अपित्वरते अस्मै, त्वर्
बा˚ड] A part, portion, share.

अपिधा {c3c} U. To shut, close,
cover, conceal.

अपिधानं, --पिधानं
1 Covering,
concealing, concealment.
--2 A cover,
lid, covering (fig. also);
[]
अमृतापिधानमसि स्वाहा; नैकजलदच्छत्रापिधानं जगत्

अपिधिः f. Concealment,
covering
--धिः What is given to another's
entire satisfaction तृप्तिपर्यंतदत्त.

अपिहित --पिहित p. p.
1 Shut, closed,
covered, concealed (fig. also);
बाष्पापिहेत covered with tears.
--2 Not
concealed, plain, clear; अर्थो
गिरामपिहितः पिहितश्च किंचित्, सत्यं
चकास्ति मरहदृवधूस्तनाभः Subhāṣ.

अपिप्राण a. (णी f.) Always
animating or vivifying (सर्वदाचेष्टमान).

अपिभाग a. Ved. Sharing or
partaking in, having a share.

अपिव्रत a. Sharing in the same
religious acts or other works;
connected by blood; अपिव्रताश्चान्वारभंते
यजमानं Kāty. (संसृष्टं साधारणकर्म येषां ते
अपिव्रताः अविभक्ता दायादाः, ते हि एकेनापि
कृष्यादिकर्म कृतं सर्वे उपजीवंति Com.).

अपिशर्वर a. Ved. Close to the
night, being at the beginning (or
end) of the night.
--रं Early or
untimely morning, evening (or
morning) time (प्रदोषमुखं).

अपिशलः N. of a man; a
grammarian; (pl.) his descendants.

अपीतिः f.
1 Entering into,
approaching.
--2 Dissolution,
destruction; loss.
--3 Destruction of the
world (प्रलय); अपीतौ तद्वत्
प्रसंगादसमंजसं Br. Sūt.

अपीच्य a.
1 Very handsome or
beautiful (अतिसुंदर).
--2 Secret,
concealed, hidden.

अपीजु a. Ved. Impelling,
stirring up.

अपीनसः [अपीनाय, अपीनत्वाय सीयते
कल्पते कर्मकर्तरि क Tv.] Dryness of the
nose; cold (in the head), rheum,
catarrh; see पीनस.

आपिः [आप्-णिच्-इन्]
1 Obtaining
wealth &c.
--2 A friend,
acquaintance, ally (बंधु); ˚त्वं friendship,
alliance.

आपिशलिः N. of an old
grammarian.

आपिशल a. Originating from
आपिशलि.
--लः A pupil of आपिशलि.

आपीन p. p. [प्यै-क्त] Stout, fat,
strong.
--नः A well; आपीनोंऽधुः Sk.
--नं An udder, teat;
आपीनभारोद्वहनप्रयत्नात्

;
भुजाभ्यां तमापीड्य clasping him to
the bosom.
--2 To press hard, afflict,
perplex, worry.
--3 To compress.

आपीड a.
1 Giving pain, hurting.
--2 Squeezing, compressing.
--3 A
chaplet (tied on the crown of the
head), garland in general;
चूडापीडकपालसंकुलगलन्मंदाकिनीवारयः

1 Compressing,
squeezing; tying tightly.
--2 Embracing,
clasping.
--3 Giving pain, hurting.

आपीडित p. p.
1 Compressed,
bound tightly; embraced &c.
--2
Decorated with chaplets.

आपीत a.
1 Yellowish.
--2
Drunk or sipped a little (as
water).
--तः Yellowish colour.
--तं A pyritic mineral (माक्षिकधातु).
